notes.title: Unknown Dungeon Demo Livestream
notes.content:
Livestream of a developer playing Unknown Dungeon Demo.

Important features:
[list]
[*]Starting from the very beginning and slowly moving through the demo.
[*]Touching the most significant gameplay and story aspects.
[*]Unlocking all available characters, upgrading them to their max levels and testing their abilities.
[*]Completing all available quests. 
[*]Exploration of all available dungeon floors and rooms.
[/list]
